finding: Unchecked integer accumulations and unbounded whole-file reads in the analysis path could wrap in release or consume uncontrolled memory on corrupt receipts.
scope: Analysis and qualification only; measured receiver/probe code and schedule unchanged.
response: Bound text reads to16MiB with growth detection; stream hashes in64KiB chunks with128MiB maximum; use checked additions/sums/subtractions for frame/span/stage/campaign/test totals; hash the same text bytes that are parsed.
qualification: Two runtime negative safety tests failed before the fix; final results retained separately.
first_release_build: build-qualification-attempt-1; never used for a performance observation
